name: kyro-sprint-executor
description: Strict end-to-end Kyro sprint execution: capability handshake, per-task context-pack -> implement -> validate -> record-evidence -> review, fail-closed on missing CLI verbs, user-approved sprint close

changes: Rewrite as a thin strict executor that defers routing to context-pack and never duplicates sprint-forge modes
Exact tool-owned CLI usage lines with scope/task flags for every stage
Step 0 capability handshake: abort fail-closed when the runtime lacks record-evidence/review
Full task cycle: blocked-after-3-rounds, emergent tasks, debt, clarification gate, checker veto semantics
Sprint close requires explicit user approval (lifecycle gate)
Projected to agent skill roots on install/sync with runtimeVersion pin
